name: Rad Maxx

features.name: Pay Direction Arrows
features.description: Extra directions in which lines pay.

features.name: Wild Plus
features.description: Activates one to three more pay directions.

review:
Rad Maxx gives Maxx the Mouse from R.I.P. City his own game, with Crazy Cat wild multipliers worth 2x to 20x. Several cats in the same win multiply together rather than add, so two mid-range cats in one line can make a big win.

The unusual mechanic is Pay Direction Arrows outside the grid. Left-to-right is always active, but Wild Plus symbols switch on one to three more directions clockwise, so the same symbols can pay in several ways. The maximum is 12,500x.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
